note: Mode-tagged should-trigger phrasings and near-miss negatives that must route elsewhere, for a company the user runs and for the user's own life. Positives cover all five modes, the portfolio weighing the Chief Operating Officer absorbed, and personal goals, decisions and the weekly review. Operate fires on work that crosses departments and decide on a call that weighs several departments' views; one department's own work, asked alone, routes to that department's skill, and a question that is money alone to finance-and-accounting.

should_trigger.q: found a company for my new idea
we have an idea for a meal-kit business, help me stand it up
start a new venture with me, from the idea to the first customers
set our strategy for next year
refresh the OKRs for this quarter
should we enter the enterprise market
help me set my goals for next year
I run two companies and a side project; how should I split my time and money between them next quarter
should I launch the product now or wait
go or no-go on the acquisition
should we sign an exclusive deal with this supplier
should I take the job offer in Denver or stay where I am
should I move to Lisbon next year
should I buy the lake cabin, weighing the money, the upkeep and how I want to spend my weekends
launch the new product across sales, legal and support
get the company ready for the seed round
get everything ready for my move: the budget, the lease and the movers
how is the company doing
run the quarterly business review
review my week: what did I commit to and what should I focus on
